Manhole.label: Manhole
Manhole.description: This object provides site specific configuration for devices operating in a sewer manhole.

Cover_level.label: Cover level
Cover_level.description: The level of the manhole cover measured relative to a height datum eg. mAHD

Sensor_face_level.label: Sensor face level
Sensor_face_level.description: The level of the freespace distance sensor relative to a height datum eg. mAHD

Invert_level.label: Invert level
Invert_level.description: The level of the manhole invert measured relative to a height datum eg. mAHD

Static_object.label: Static object
Static_object.description: The level of a static object (eg. platform, ladder, etc.) in the manhole measured relative to a height datum eg. mAHD
